item: Unread floor no longer hides an unread law catalogue (row 319)
summary: floor_report carried one reason; when the floor file listed no country its sentence replaced the catalogue's error, so report, read-back and the Living sources panel lost it when both failed. A catalog_reason key now sits beside the floor's read state (null when the catalogue was read); the read-back prints it as its own line; the panel says 'The law catalogue could not be read either.' (1 string x12) with the error as data.
